originating_session_goal: make explicit style and genre characteristics govern StegMusic composition, beginning with high-energy EDM, bass drops, and a federal-security-floor requirement
claim_expiration_or_release_condition: release when a fresh current-main implementation PR is merged after static, browser, hosted, artifact, and live-route validation; otherwise expire after 14 days without a commit or workflow receipt

source_history.reason: stale and non-mergeable; requirements transferred without reviving obsolete integration history

requirements: resolve natural-language style preferences into explicit inspectable characteristics
treat genre labels as descriptive references rather than render authority

support an EDM high-energy bass-drop profile with tempo, energy, bass weight, drop prominence, danceability, percussion density, brightness, harmonic complexity, melodic activity, and tension-release characteristics
make the active profile govern composition structure rather than only UI controls
render at least 32 bars and at least two materially distinct drops for the EDM profile
withhold or reduce bass and kick energy before each drop
introduce sub-bass, impact transients, increased rhythmic density, and sustained post-drop energy at release
make the second release structurally larger than the first
retain compression, peak normalization, no-upload, and human-audibility boundaries
record profile ID, characteristic contract, required events, total bars, drop count, and render evidence
treat applicable federal security controls as a minimum floor and prohibit claims of exceeding them without mapped evidence and assessment

security_floor.policy: applicable United States federal cybersecurity requirements are the minimum acceptable baseline, not the target
required_controls: no unauthorized source-audio upload or retention
security_floor.claim_boundary: no claim that StegMusic or StegVerse exceeds a federal baseline is permitted without an applicable control mapping, implementation evidence, validation results, and independent assessment

collision_boundaries: do not revive or extend PR 78
do not create another ST-018 evidence implementation lane
do not modify user-owned audio handling to upload source bytes
do not convert browser or workflow evidence into activation, rights, custody, or publication authority

next_executable_action.action: create a fresh implementation branch from current main and port only the required style registry, resolver, runtime integration, and tests

machine_observable_release_condition: a current-main PR containing the required surfaces passes all required hosted checks, its artifacts are inspected, it merges, and the live route receipt observes the deployed files

transferred_requirements: bass drops and long-form energy arc
